articles.title: Fifa to share 'key documents' over World Cup sell-off plan
articles.summary: Council members will need to travel to Fifa's headquarters in Zurich to see the documents, and will be subject to "strict review protocols".

articles.title: Key questions as Pocognoli prepares to name Scotland squad
articles.summary: Sebastien Pocognoli names his second Scotland squad on Tuesday, with various dilemmas to address.

articles.title: Tenerife player in intensive care with injury
articles.summary: Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel is in a stable condition in intensive care after suffering a serious injury during a Spanish second division match on Monday.

articles.title: England to host South Africa live on Sky Sports in Netball World Cup prep
articles.summary: England's Vitality Roses will host South Africa in a three-Test netball series in February, with all matches live on Sky Sports.

articles.title: Carney urges RFL to adopt strategic plan after England's World Cup exits
articles.summary: Brian Carney has urged the Rugby Football League (RFL) to get serious about its ambitions to strengthen the domestic game in England by implementing a strategic plan.
